title: Diagnostic Report: Bash (TFG)
summary: Bash.com, TFG's multi-brand e-commerce platform with approximately 9M monthly visits, presents significant SEO and content opportunities. Product pages lack structured data (JSON-LD), no editorial content engine was detected, and Next.js static assets are served with max-age=0 cache headers — collectively limiting organic growth and conversion potential across thousands of product and category pages.
